title: Tuna and olive orzo
summary: Tuna and olive orzo is a italian dinner built around tuna in spring water and orzo pasta, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Start the sauce for Tuna and olive orzo: soften the onion, then add garlic and orzo pasta. Season tuna in spring water and have the pasta water on to boil.
steps.tip: Salt the pasta water. It is the only chance to season the noodles themselves.

steps.instruction: Cook tuna in spring water in the sauce while the pasta boils until tender with a bite. Save a cup of the cooking water before you drain.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening it with a splash of pasta water so it clings to cherry tomatoes.
steps.tip: Taste Tuna and olive orzo before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Serve Tuna and olive orzo straight away in warm bowls.  Serve with the orzo, simmered in salted water until tender.
